Name: Abimelech, Son of Gideon
Summary: Abimelech, son of Gideon by his Shechemite concubine, murdered his seventy brothers, was made king by the men of Shechem, and died at Thebez when a woman dropped a millstone on his head. He is distinct from Abimelech, king of Gerar, in Genesis.
KeyStory: Abimelech hired vain men with temple silver, slew his brothers on one stone, was crowned at Shechem, burned the tower of Shechem, and was mortally wounded at Thebez by a piece of a millstone, asking his armourbearer to finish him lest men say a woman slew him.
RelatedPeople: Gideon; Jotham, Son of Gideon; Zebul; Gaal, Son of Ebed
LifeLesson: A crown bought with brothers' blood ends under a millstone.
